current_activity: Gruppe Witte withdraws into the Kettwig switch position; on the morning of 14 April the corps right wing is on the Ruhr near Kettwig
notes: Event date: night 13/14 April to morning 14 April 1945 (typed p.-79- (Fold3 page 84)) (FMS B-709 (Ulms and Reuther), English translation). Event definition: given the Rhine front up to Duisburg on 12-13 April, Gruppe Witte withdraws into the Kettwig switch position on the night 13/14 April without enemy pressure; on the morning of 14 April the corps right wing stands on the Ruhr near Kettwig in contact with LXIII Corps.
